question_text: What do we show loyalty to when we say the Pledge of Allegiance?

why_it_matters.text: The Pledge is a public promise of loyalty to the United States and to its flag — the symbol that stands for the country. Saying it is a ritual that connects you to every American who has said the same words.

fun_fact.text: In 1943, during World War II, the Supreme Court ruled that no one in the U.S. can be forced to say the Pledge — even at school. Forcing someone to declare loyalty would violate the First Amendment. So when you say the Pledge, you're choosing to. Real loyalty is freely given, not commanded.
